# Writing Plans

Create a concrete plan before editing code when the task is large or ambiguous.

## Workflow

1. Identify the expected outcome.
2. Map the files or modules likely to change.
3. Break work into small ordered tasks.
4. Save plan items through the planning tool.
5. Keep the plan updated as tasks complete.
